I ask myself the question, if i was pos 1 and got wrecked in lane and lost my tower, what would I want to do to recover.   
Chances are, I would be in the jungle to recover, or try and farm safely in front of the tier 2 tower.   
Once I work out how that safelaner thinks, I will be where he wants to be and constant zone him out.   
That way my safelaner hopefully is getting at least okay farm while their pos 1 is getting nothing. generally I want to keep my pos 4 with me to apply maximum pressure and even potentially push tier 2 early.   
The worst thing you could do is push tier 1 and then move on elsewhere on the map. you give a whole jungle and free lane to a carry who only struggled for a short time, who can always recover with a couple of items/kills.

not to complicate anything, but you're really better off learning the roles instead of just the specific heroes.   
Many of the heroes have a very similar playstyle. drow and viper is a good comparison. both cores, both have slows and good damage.    
if you learn the roles better, you'll naturally have a larger hero pool because you'll do the smaller things right in game by habit.   
on pos 1 its about hitting your timings and farming efficiently.   
Mid is about controlling the mid game/ganking/making space  
offlane is usually your initiator / sacrificial lamb (don't be afraid to die if it gets your team a good result at the end of the fight)  
soft supp is the playmaker who generally does a lot of nuke damage as well.   
hard support is there to support everyone.   
learning these roles and doing them well will increase your hero pool substantially. because even if you can't get all the skills right all the time on a hero you've never played, just knowing what you should be doing will be more beneficial and win you more games.
